question.problem: Given that ${lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{1-18{x}^{2}}{12p{x}^{2}-3x+9}=-2,$  what is the value of $p?$

current_example.worked_solution:
First, we divide both the numerator and the denominator by the highest power of $x$ in the denominator, which is $x^4.$ Then, by noting that the reciprocals shrink to $0$ in the limit, we can then evaluate the resulting expression.

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{3{x}^{4}+9x}{6{x}^{4}-{x}^{3}} & ={lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{(\frac{3{x}^{4}}{{x}^{4}}+\frac{9x}{{x}^{4}})}{(\frac{6{x}^{4}}{{x}^{4}}-\frac{{x}^{3}}{{x}^{4}})} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{(3+\frac{9}{{x}^{3}})}{(6-\frac{1}{x})} \\  & =\frac{3+0}{6-0} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
